text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear pro-driverless thesis in the opening and closing","quality":"argumentative stance","description":"The essay states a consistent position and keeps returning to that claim throughout the piece."},{"evidence":"three body paragraphs on fuel, flexibility, and safety","quality":"organization","description":"The essay groups its points into distinct sections that are easy to follow."},{"evidence":"explanations like 'because less people would need to be hired' and 'people will have more time during their commute'","quality":"development","description":"The essay does more than name benefits by explaining how each point would work in practice."},{"evidence":"discussion of 'some people may say' boredom and in-car entertainment","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"The essay acknowledges a possible objection and responds to it rather than ignoring the other side."},{"evidence":"specific use of the article's ideas about fuel use, flexibility, and safety features","quality":"textual support","description":"The essay connects its claims to multiple relevant details from the source article."}]}
